question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

She **avoids to go to crowded places**.

options.text: is avoiding to go to crowded place

solution:
The correct answer is '**avoids going to crowded places**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The verb "**avoids**" is followed by a gerund (verb + ing) when describing an action that is being avoided. 
 
• The phrase "going to crowded places" is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning clearly.
